info.name: Newsletter Backend
info.description: Requests for evaluating the Newsletter Go API. Set collection variables after creating a category or article where needed.

item.name: Create published article
item.description: After a successful response, copy its id and slug into the articleId and articleSlug collection variables. The sample article has no category; category_id is optional.

body.raw:
{
  "slug": "postman-draft-{{$timestamp}}",
  "title": "Postman Draft",
  "author": "Evaluation Author",
  "description": "A draft is returned by /articles/all, not /articles.",
  "contents": { "type": "doc", "content": [{ "type": "paragraph", "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": "Draft content." }] }] },
  "cover_image": null,
  "published_at": null,
  "tags": [],
  "category_id": null,
  "status": "draft",
  "type": "newsletter",
  "estimated_read_time": 2
}

item.name: Update article

body.raw:
{
  "slug": "postman-evaluation-updated-{{$timestamp}}",
  "title": "Updated Postman Article",
  "author": "Evaluation Author",
  "description": "Updated article description.",
  "contents": { "type": "doc", "content": [{ "type": "paragraph", "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": "Updated Tiptap content." }] }] },
  "cover_image": null,
  "published_at": "{{$isoTimestamp}}",
  "tags": ["updated"],
  "category_id": null,
  "status": "published",
  "type": "newsletter",
  "estimated_read_time": 4
}

item.description: Update requires the full required article payload. Change articleId to an existing article UUID.

item.name: Delete article
item.description: Permanently deletes this article and cascades deletion to its comments. Use only with a test article.

item.name: Subscribe
item.description: Use a new email each time; duplicate addresses return 409 Conflict.
